evidence.requirements: The delivered `app/` root contains only .editorconfig, .gitattributes and .gitignore. There is no package.json and no source. All the code is in `app/.worktrees/kieselbrunnen-tastings/`, a git worktree (its .git file points to /work/.git/worktrees/...) that was never merged, and `.worktrees/` is gitignored (app/.gitignore:7). So `npm install && npm run build && npm start` fails in the delivered folder, which breaks 'Running it'. All four screenshots are missing, which fits the app being unreachable. Inside the worktree the features match the brief: start page with title, date/time, EUR price and 'n seats left' (TastingCard.tsx:21-41); 'Book <title>' links (TastingCard.tsx:47-49); a form with Name/Email/Guests (1-8) and a 'Book' button (BookingForm.tsx:91-148); errors shown next to each field; the 'Booking confirmed' page shows the tasting, guests, total and reference (ConfirmationPage.tsx:66-78); /staff has a Password field and Sign in button and uses STAFF_PASSWORD (index.ts:11); bookings are grouped with a Cancel button (StaffPage.tsx:210-283); cancelling frees seats (booking-store.ts:82). The phone layout and polished look cannot be checked because there are no screenshots.
evidence.correctness: The seat check and the reservation happen in one synchronous call (booking-store.ts:59-76), so concurrent requests cannot overbook in single-threaded Node. Zod validates on both client and server (booking-schema.ts:21-38), including trim, email format, integer and 1..8. Unknown tastings get a 404, and when a booking would exceed the seats the server returns 409 with a 'Only n seats left' message shown at the Guests field (app.ts:62-73, BookingForm.tsx:51-61). Cancelling deletes the booking, which frees its seats (tested in app.test.ts:192-206). Minor issues: the staff header says '1 guests booked' (StaffPage.tsx:233); Cancel acts immediately with no confirmation (StaffPage.tsx:265-271); and if the response is not JSON, `JSON.parse` in api.ts:33 throws.
evidence.security: React escapes all output. Passwords are compared in constant time over SHA-256 digests (staff-auth.ts:7-12). The trailing `given === expected` is redundant but harmless. Session tokens are 32 random bytes, stored server-side with an 8-hour TTL (staff-auth.ts:34). The cookie is httpOnly and SameSite=Strict (app.ts:106-111) but has no `secure` flag. Also in place: helmet with CSP, a 10kb JSON limit, rate-limited sign-in (app.ts:87-95), a generic error handler, and a public booking endpoint that leaves out name and email (app.ts:179-188). No secrets are in the code. Staff sign-in is disabled when STAFF_PASSWORD is unset (index.ts:13-15).
evidence.code_quality: The structure is clean: server/shared/client split, and one shared zod schema used by react-hook-form and the API. Discriminated-union result types (booking-store.ts:19-22, api.ts:43-45) and explicit loading, error and not-found states on every page make the code readable. Naming is good and the size fits the task. Minor issues: the date/price/seats `<dl>` markup is duplicated between TastingCard.tsx:21-41 and BookingPage.tsx:75-93, and `formatTime` is an identity function (format.ts:20-22).
evidence.tests: There are meaningful Vitest suites. Supertest API tests (app.test.ts) cover listing, creation with total price, invalid input, the seat limit (409), fully booked, unknown tasting, auth, cancellation freeing seats, sign-out, the SPA fallback, headers and rate limiting. Store unit tests cover the exact-capacity boundary and cancellation (booking-store.test.ts). RTL page tests check field errors via accessible descriptions, the fully booked state, the staff flows, and a full App journey (App.test.tsx:30-67). Gaps: no end-to-end/browser test against the real server, and the whole suite sits in an unmerged, gitignored worktree, so it does not travel with the repository.
evidence.ux_design: All screenshots are missing (no start.jpg, form.jpg, confirmation.jpg or staff.jpg), so the automated check could not reach any page. From the code, the design looks deliberate: a wine/cream/gold palette, Fraunces display type, cards, a Fully booked badge, a muted sold-out state, alert styles and responsive grids (index.css, TastingCard.tsx). None of this can be seen in the screenshots, and guests could not use the delivered app.
evidence.accessibility: Labels are linked with htmlFor/id. Error inputs get aria-invalid, and aria-describedby links each input to its error and hint (BookingForm.tsx:100-142). Request-level errors use role=alert, loading states use role=status, and there is a skip link, a visible focus outline (index.css:49-52), lang=en, landmark regions, table headers with scope, and Cancel buttons described by their reference (StaffPage.tsx:268). react-hook-form moves focus to the first invalid field by default, but field-level errors are not live regions. Several texts use reduced-opacity colours (text-wine-800/70) whose contrast cannot be checked without screenshots.
evidence.simplicity: The stack is Express, React, react-router, react-hook-form, zod and Tailwind, plus helmet, rate-limit and cookie-parser. These fit the brief's request for established libraries. The amount of code is moderate, with no needless layers. In-memory storage fits the brief.
evidence.maintainability: There is no README, docs, ADRs, specs or staff manual anywhere. There is no CI configuration. The code, package.json and package-lock.json live only in a gitignored `.worktrees/` directory and are missing from the delivered project root (app/.gitignore:7), so a new developer gets an essentially empty repository. Dependencies use caret ranges; a lockfile exists only in the worktree. engines is `>=22` and there is no .nvmrc. There is no versioning or release approach beyond version 1.0.0.

unmet_requirements: Running it: `npm install` / `npm run build` / `npm start` in the delivered folder fails because package.json and all source code are only in an unmerged, gitignored `.worktrees/kieselbrunnen-tastings` directory; no page could be reached (all screenshots missing)
Look and feel (polished design, clear states, usable on a phone) cannot be verified because no page was reachable
Process: no specs, plans, review records or docs were delivered (openspec/docs folders are absent)
strengths: Correct, race-free booking logic: one shared zod schema validates on client and server, and server-side 409 seat-limit errors are shown at the Guests field
Solid staff security: constant-time hashed password comparison, random server-side sessions with TTL, httpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie, rate-limited sign-in, helmet CSP
Meaningful test suite (supertest API, store unit tests, RTL page and journey tests) that checks the brief's labels, errors and cancellation behaviour
issues: The work was never merged: the delivered project root has no package.json or source (everything is in a gitignored `.worktrees/` git worktree), so the app cannot be installed or started as the brief requires, and no screenshot could be taken
No README, run/setup instructions, staff manual, specs/ADRs or CI pipeline; a new developer gets an essentially empty repository
Smaller product gaps: Cancel deletes a booking immediately with no confirmation, '1 guests booked' pluralisation, and no secure cookie flag or end-to-end test against the running server
review.verdict: The code inside the worktree is well structured, secure and well tested, and appears to meet nearly every feature in the brief. But the delivered folder holds no runnable app, docs or CI because the work was never merged out of a gitignored worktree, so it cannot be shipped to the winery as is.
